description: 17 animated species assets. Source meshes/textures are acquired assets; ensemble_* clips are newly authored skeletal animation, not official/native animation.

arceus.name: Arceus
notes: ensemble_idle, ensemble_enter and ensemble_attack are authored anatomical skeletal clips, not source/native game animation.
Foreleg brace, raised neck, head-directed Judgment pulse and tail settle.

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

breloom.name: Breloom
notes: ensemble_idle, ensemble_enter and ensemble_attack are authored anatomical skeletal clips, not source/native game animation.
Rooted rear legs, shoulder windup, right arm seed-punch thrust, head follow-through and tail counterbalance.

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

cinderace.name: Cinderace
notes: ensemble_idle, ensemble_enter and ensemble_attack are authored anatomical skeletal clips, not source/native game animation.
Arms balance a right thigh lift, knee fold, foot strike and controlled leg recovery.

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

cleffa.name: Cleffa
notes: ensemble_idle, ensemble_enter and ensemble_attack are authored anatomical skeletal clips, not source/native game animation.
Small-foot brace, raised arms and ears, forward head pulse and soft settle.

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

notes: ensemble_idle, ensemble_enter and ensemble_attack are authored anatomical skeletal clips, not source/native game animation.

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

gardevoir.name: Gardevoir
notes: ensemble_idle, ensemble_enter and ensemble_attack are authored anatomical skeletal clips, not source/native game animation.

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

bounds.method: CPU-skinned world-space vertices at ensemble_idle t=0

canonicalWrapper.reason: The source fan-art mesh uses Z-up local coordinates, a tilted Sketchfab presentation and world units thousands of times larger than the other characters. A parent transform canonicalizes its local -Y forward/+Z up basis to +Z forward/+Y up and a 1.4-unit height before rig transfer; source vertex/normal/UV/index buffers and original nodes remain unchanged.

rigTransfer.method: Source anatomical skeleton and eight-neighbor interpolated rest-surface skin weights transferred from HOME to the textured source mesh; target positions, UVs, indices, normals and encoded textures retained.

arceus.timeUnits: source clip seconds; authored clip runs at speed 1
arceus.coordinateUnits: tip and forward are absolute points in named bone-local space
arceus.evidence: Newly authored action; timing is an authored envelope, not extracted game event metadata. Socket points are measured from CPU-skinned source geometry at t=0.9 and transformed into the animated joint local space. Forward is authored +Z at release (Forretress follows each native cannon axis), then follows the joint. These are geometric effect attachments, not official move events.

emitters.method: Centroid of frontmost 8% of vertices influenced by the named joint and descendants at release pose.
